meta.name: positioning-workshop
meta.description: Run a positioning workshop that surfaces target customer, unmet need, category, benefits, and differentiation. Use when your product messaging feels fuzzy, generic, or misaligned.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 明确产品定位和差异化信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果产品宣传信息模糊或缺乏差异化。
copy.tagline_en: Clarify your product positioning and differentiation.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your product messaging feels fuzzy or generic.

howto.what: 引导你通过5个自适应问题，逐步明确目标客户、未满足需求、产品类别、核心利益和竞争差异，最终生成一份Geoffrey Moore定位声明。
howto.when: 当你感觉产品信息模糊、泛泛或不一致时，你可以要求它运行一次定位工作坊。

say.text: 帮我为我们的B2B分析产品运行一次定位工作坊。
我们的信息太泛了，请引导一次定位会议。
我们需要定义服务对象和独特之处。

howto.what_en: Guides you through 5 adaptive questions to identify target customer, unmet need, category, benefit, and differentiation, then outputs a Geoffrey Moore positioning statement.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to run a positioning workshop because your product messaging feels fuzzy, generic, or misaligned.

say_en.text: Help me run a positioning workshop for our B2B analytics product.
Our messaging feels generic. Facilitate a positioning session.
We need to define who we serve and why we're different.
